title: Pearl Barley with Two Mushrooms
summary: Browned shiitake and chestnut mushrooms simmered with pearl barley and finished with parsley.
equipment: large deep frying pan or casserole with lid

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Brown
steps.text: Fry the shiitake in the oil over medium heat 8-10 min, stirring now and then, until browned at the edges.

steps.title: Wilt
steps.text: Add the chestnut mushrooms, salt and pepper, cover and cook on low 5 min until they release their juice.

steps.title: Simmer
steps.text: Stir in the barley and water, cover and simmer on medium-low 35-40 min until the barley is plump and tender and the liquid is absorbed; add a splash of water if it dries out first.

steps.title: Finish
steps.text: Stir through most of the parsley and scatter the rest on top.

tips: Do not crowd the shiitake or they will steam instead of brown.
Add more water if the barley is still firm when the pan is dry.
A squeeze of lemon lifts the flavour.
storage: Keep covered in the fridge for up to 3 days; reheat with a splash of water. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
